# Component: engine

Files: `src/engine.ts` (1508 lines), `src/expression.ts` (125), `src/types.ts` (225). Criticality: **Core**.

## 1. Component Overview
This is the one simulation core, shared by the browser, the route simulator and the validator. A single `GameEngine` class owns:

- world state and the 1-second activity tick;
- the time bank;
- derived-field recomputation;
- combat, played out one exchange at a time;
- tooltips.

`src/expression.ts` is the restricted expression language in which every `require`, `need` and amount string is written. `src/types.ts` holds the record and state vocabulary. [HIGH]

- Stack: TypeScript, with no runtime dependencies and no DOM or I/O. `src/engine.ts:1-2` imports only `./expression` and `./types`. [HIGH]
- Entry point: `new GameEngine(records, state?)` at `src/engine.ts:84`. [HIGH]
- Complexity: **Complex**. It is one class of about 1440 lines with a fixed-point recompute and interacting slot, queue, bank and fight rules. [HIGH]

## 3. Workflows & Behaviors
**WF-engine:001 — Start an action** (user-facing). Triggered by a UI click or the route runner.
1. If the same id is already running, only the objective changes and nothing is paid twice → `src/engine.ts:560-566`
2. The `availability(id)` gate checks visibility, locks, `need`, affordability and reserves → `src/engine.ts:567-568`, `src/engine.ts:379`
3. While a fight is undecided, no other timed action may start → `src/engine.ts:569`
4. For a sustained action, the current one stops. The interrupted pursuit goes to the **front** of the waiting list, unless it is an `autoStart` filler, and **only while the list has room** → `src/engine.ts:576-583`
5. Payment: instant actions pay on every click; timed actions pay their entry bill once (the `paid` flag) → `src/engine.ts:585-590`
6. An instant action runs `complete()`, reconciles and fills the idle slot; a sustained one becomes `state.active` → `src/engine.ts:595-605`

Player-facing refusals return `{ ok: false, reason }` and never throw. [HIGH]

**WF-engine:002 — Advance wall time** (background; `src/main.ts` calls it every second, and once for away time).
1. Add the carried sub-second remainder, then fill an empty slot (waiting list first, then `autoStart`) → `src/engine.ts:681-683`, `src/engine.ts:764-771`
2. While at least 1 s remains, tick the active run; if accelerating, also spend one bank second per wall second → `src/engine.ts:686-691`, `src/engine.ts:728-733`
3. A run that fails to tick three times in a row is cleared without a journal line ("must not spin") → `src/engine.ts:692-695`
4. With no active run, regenerate passively and bank the seconds, up to the cap → `src/engine.ts:698-710`, `src/engine.ts:1327-1331`
5. Any remainder is kept as `wallRemainder` while running, otherwise banked → `src/engine.ts:713-714`

Discoveries and story events are logged during the tick but **never stop the run** (see BR-engine:004). [HIGH]

**WF-engine:003 — One activity tick** → `src/engine.ts:911-971`.
1. Rest yields to a waiting pursuit that can resume.
2. An unsustainable drain pauses the run.
3. Resources regenerate; `run` and `strain` drain, and `effect` applies.
4. Continuous runs count ticks. Timed runs accumulate progress × speed and call `complete()` at `length`.
5. An encounter enters its fight on the first second and plays each exchange as progress reaches it. A decided fight ends the run early (`src/engine.ts:943-946`).
6. A lost encounter clears the slot without requeueing (`src/engine.ts:950-955`). [HIGH]

**WF-engine:004 — Completion** → `src/engine.ts:1088-1127`.
1. The timed entry resets.
2. An encounter settles from the Strike, Guard and Life captured when the fight began; a loss returns early with journal text.
3. Reps and value increment.
4. `recompute()` runs **before** `result`, so caps raised by this completion apply to its own payout (`src/engine.ts:1114-1115`).
5. The first completion applies `mod`, and an instant record's locks; a timed record's locks already fell when its entry bill was paid (`payEntry`, ADR 0027). [HIGH]

**WF-engine:005 — Reconcile** → `src/engine.ts:1237-1272`. Loops to a fixed point:
- reveals records whose `require` holds and logs "is now known.", except for flags;
- fires each narrative event once (`eventIds`);
- pauses an active run whose chapter was locked;
- logs cap lines. [HIGH]

## 4. Business Rules
| ID | Rule | Criticality | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| BR-engine:001 | Only `recompute` writes `max`/`rate`/`open`/`length`/`yield`/`discount`; it runs after every mutation and on load | Core | `src/types.ts:28-29`, `src/engine.ts:198-212` |
| BR-engine:002 | Recompute iterates to a fixed point, at most 8 passes | Core | `src/engine.ts:206-211` |
| BR-engine:003 | Content with duplicate record ids throws at construction | Core | `src/engine.ts:87` |
| BR-engine:004 | Discoveries and events are logged but never pause activity or away-time settlement | Core | `src/engine.ts:1243-1261`, `tests/engine.test.ts:284-294` |
| BR-engine:005 | The waiting list holds at most 6; a displaced or blocked pursuit is requeued only if there is room | Supporting | `src/engine.ts:6`, `src/engine.ts:581`, `src/engine.ts:1312` |
| BR-engine:006 | Timed runs pay their entry bill once; stopping keeps progress | Core | `src/engine.ts:586-590`, `src/engine.ts:663` |
| BR-engine:007 | The bank's base cap is 3600 s; the balance is clamped to the derived cap | Supporting | `src/engine.ts:9`, `src/engine.ts:260-261` |
| BR-engine:008 | Stopping the activity clears acceleration and banks the sub-second remainder | Supporting | `src/engine.ts:661-670` |
| BR-engine:009 | Reaching family level N costs `EXP_PER_LEVEL × N` experience (60 × N) | Core | `src/engine.ts:10`, `src/engine.ts:1212-1213` |
| BR-engine:010 | Discounts are capped at 0.5 | Supporting | `src/engine.ts:8`, `src/engine.ts:461` |
| BR-engine:011 | Fights read the fixed ids `life`/`strike`/`guard`; only the `max` of Strike and Guard counts; you strike first | Core | `src/engine.ts:15-17`, `src/engine.ts:984-1017` |
| BR-engine:012 | A fight's course is fixed by the Strike, Guard and Life held when it starts; Life falls blow by blow | Core | `src/engine.ts:1062-1079` |
| BR-engine:013 | An undecided fight cannot be stopped or replaced by another timed action | Core | `src/engine.ts:18`, `src/engine.ts:569`, `src/engine.ts:649-658` |
| BR-engine:014 | The journal keeps the latest 160 entries | Peripheral | `src/engine.ts:1324` |
| BR-engine:015 | Expressions: at most 4096 chars, 512 tokens and depth 64; `__proto__`, `prototype` and `constructor` are rejected | Core | `src/expression.ts:50` |

## 5. Data Models
- **GameRecord** (`src/types.ts:47`): one content record.
  - Kinds: 14 (`src/types.ts:4`).
  - Gating: `require`/`need`/`needtext`.
  - Costs and duration: `buy`/`cost`/`run`/`strain`, `length`.
  - Payouts: `effect`/`result`/`mod`/`perLevel`/`at`/`every`.
  - Closing and opening others: `lock`/`enable`/`warn`.
  - Techniques: `attune`/`held`.
  - Also: `tags`, `encounter`, `breakthrough`, `autoStart`, `fill`, `boost`, `slot`/`slots`/`space`.
- **Stat** (`src/types.ts:11`): per-record runtime numbers. The authoritative ones are `value`/`exp`/`reps`/`ticks`/`started`/`paid`; the other six are derived.
- **WorldState / GameState** (`src/types.ts:155`, `src/types.ts:200`): stats, the active task, the waiting list, visible and locked ids, the attuned list, event ids, cap hits, the log, `wallRemainder`, `lastStop`, and the recorded `fight` (`src/types.ts:174`). `GameState` adds `bank` (`src/types.ts:147`).
- **FightState / LiveFight** (`src/types.ts:178`, `src/types.ts:189`): what a fight was entered with, and its projected course with progress.
- **Objective** (`src/types.ts:127`): `repetitions`, `level` or `resource`, with a target.
- **Encounter / FightOutcome** (`src/types.ts:111`, `src/types.ts:119`).
- Enumerations: `DERIVED_FIELDS` (`src/types.ts:29`) and `TOOLTIP_BLOCKS` (`src/types.ts:210`, which now includes `fight`).

## 10. Legacy Warnings
- God class: `GameEngine` spans about 1440 lines and about 100 methods, which makes it a high-risk zone. Run `bun test` and `bun run validate` after every change. [HIGH]

## 11. Design Rationale
| Pattern | Location | Rationale | Evidence | Certainty |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Derived fields rebuilt; only history saved | `src/engine.ts:198-212` | A late upgrade raises what early levels already gave, and saves stay valid across content edits | ADR 0021; `src/persistence.ts:9-10` | HIGH |
| Patches folded in before payout | `src/engine.ts:235-246` | `X.mod.Y` reaches every level and unit X already has | code comment `src/engine.ts:235` | HIGH |
| Recompute before applying `result` | `src/engine.ts:1114-1115` | Caps raised by a completion must stand before its own payout lands | code comment | HIGH |
| Stall guard | `src/engine.ts:692-695` | Content that can never tick must not spin the loop | code comment | HIGH |
| Discoveries never pause | `src/engine.ts:1411-1424` | `pauseOnReveal` was removed, and the validator rejects `pause` events | `scripts/validate.ts:39`, `scripts/validate.ts:171`, ADR 0027 | HIGH |
| Fight snapshot at entry | `src/engine.ts:1180` | Stats and whole Life captured at entry, so the projected win chance describes the fight that is played even if held methods change mid-fight | ADR 0026 | HIGH |
